verdicts.reason: A keeps headline, subcopy and CTA as a tight, well-spaced group with a clear reading order. Its flaws are a small NEW badge jammed into the top-left corner, large dead gaps around the jar, and empty space below the CTA. B blows the NEW badge up so it competes with the headline. It also leaves a big gap between the headline and its subcopy, while the subcopy is squeezed almost onto the Shop Now button, which itself sits right against the bottom edge.
